name: Tears of a Mermaid
source:
They say everything is better under the sea, but that couldn't be further from the truth! Aurielle has seen nothing but misery.

Deemed an outcast because of her pink hair, Aurielle has lived a lonely life. Her father has all but disowned her, her sister bullies her at every turn, and her relatives avoid her like the plague? Will our little mermaid get her happy ending ? Guess you better play!
